ranks: Reign of Dragons precon (FDC, Lathliss, Dragon Queen)

blocked.name: Chandra's Ignition
blocked.why: The targeted creature is the source of the damage to each other creature and each opponent; damage/damage-all deal damage only from the resolving spell or a trigger object (`from: "trigger-object"`), never from a target slot.

blocked.name: Cursed Mirror
blocked.why: 'As this artifact enters, you may have it become a copy of any creature on the battlefield until end of turn, except it has haste': copyOnEnter is a permanent copy, with no until-end-of-turn duration and no haste exception.

blocked.name: Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest
blocked.why: At your next end step, 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled this way that is still exiled; a delayed trigger's `about: "exiled"` targets exist but no amount counts how many of them are still in exile.

blocked.name: The Elder Dragon War
blocked.why: Read ahead (choose a starting chapter as the Saga enters) is unmodeled; chapter II's 'discard any number of cards, then draw that many' has no vocabulary either.

blocked.name: Leyline Tyrant
blocked.why: 'You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end' as a static (persists exists only on the add-mana that makes it), and 'pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage'.

blocked.name: Minion of the Mighty
blocked.why: Pack tactics needs the total power attacked with this combat as a recorded fact; an attacking:true aggregate at resolution drifts from the declaration (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Sarkhan, Dragon Ascendant
blocked.why: Behold a Dragon (choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand) has no vocabulary; skipping the reveal would hide information the card shows.

blocked.name: Scourge of the Throne
blocked.why: 'Whenever this creature attacks for the first time each turn, if …': oncePerTurn doesn't match (a first attack whose intervening-if failed would still leave a later attack able to trigger), and attackedThisTurn is already true as the trigger is checked.

blocked.name: Thundermane Dragon
blocked.why: Look at the top card any time (a private look, not revealsOwnLibraryTop), and 'if you cast a creature spell this way, it gains haste' — playFromLibraryTop has the filter but no rider on what was cast through it.

blocked.name: Anger
blocked.why: 'As long as this card is in your graveyard and you control a Mountain, creatures you control have haste': statics work only from the battlefield (and the command zone for cost modification).

blocked.name: Carnelian Orb of Dragonkind
blocked.why: 'If that mana is spent on a Dragon creature spell, it gains haste until end of turn': whenSpent fires a triggered ability above the spell; nothing grants a characteristic to the spell/permanent the mana paid for.
